exercises.why: **собираю** — собира́ть (imperfective): to gather, to collect, to harvest; to assemble; to convoke; (for a journey) to equip, to prepare. Wiktionary: со- + -бира́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **разобрал** — разобра́ть (perfective): to dismantle, to disassemble, to take apart, to deconstruct; to analyse, to parse; to take, buy up, snap up; to make out, read. Wiktionary: разо- + брать.
